input.prompt: Summarize notes.md in one sentence for visitors.

files.notes.md: The library will open at 9 a.m. on Saturday. The book drop will remain available overnight. The Sunday schedule is unchanged.

expectedBehavior: Use the summarization skill, then produce a concise sentence covering the Saturday opening and book drop.

grading.notes: Require a recorded invocation of the bound summarization skill in the skill-enabled arm.

The sentence states that the library opens at 9 a.m. on Saturday and the book drop stays available overnight. Mentioning the unchanged Sunday schedule is optional. Fail for a new fact or an invented closure.
